Product Features

  • Clever size design: This lift-top coffee table measures 120 x 50 x 43 cm, with a balanced length-to-width ratio. It adapts to a variety of living space layouts, doesn't take up too much room, yet offers extensive functionality.
  • Flexible height adjustment: The desk can be raised to a maximum height of 57.5 cm to meet the needs of various usage scenarios. Whether you want to relax with a cup of coffee or raise your laptop, it can be easily adjusted.
  • Hidden storage space: Beneath the desktop is a hidden storage compartment divided into three compartments by a partition. You can sort and store items such as remote controls, magazines, snacks, etc., to keep the desktop tidy.
  • Double-sided storage expansion: On each side of the table there are two semi-open storage areas suitable for placing frequently used books, decorations, etc., which can be easily removed and reflect personal taste and living atmosphere.
  • Sturdy metal table legs: Equipped with four 18 cm high metal legs, they not only offer stable support, but the golden look also gives the coffee table a touch of luxury and complements the white table body and the natural wood tabletop.
  • No dead corners and easy to clean: The unique design ensures that the coffee table has no dead corners to clean, making daily cleaning simple and effortless. Simply wipe it gently to keep it clean and tidy.
  • High-quality material guarantee: Made of MDF material, the recommended total load capacity is 30 kg. It can stably support everyday items, is robust and durable, and does not easily deform after prolonged use.
  • Beautiful color coordination: The white table body is matched to the original wooden tabletop, and the golden table legs are simple yet stylish and can easily be integrated into various interior design styles such as modern, Nordic, and light luxury.
  • Careful attention to detail: From the flexible lifting design to the numerous storage compartments and details without dead corners for cleaning, every detail reflects the careful consideration of user needs and ensures more comfort and quality in the living room.
